Use case: identity-preserve.
Asset type: production sprite animation for Lyra in KillQuest.
Input image 1 is the APPROVED exact character, palette, outfit, proportions, face and body-scale seed on expanded transparent canvas. Input image 2 is her current aerial animation/reference for broad curved blade slashes and tasteful silver crescent trails; do not copy the jump poses.
Generate a SINGLE coherent sprite sheet with EXACTLY NINE full-body poses, a 3-column by 3-row grid on transparent background. Read row-major. The FIRST EIGHT cells are consecutive frames of ONE ground attack. Cell 9 (bottom-right) is an extra SCALE WITNESS: copy the seed's upright neutral standing pose, same body anatomy and same scale as the eight action poses. It is not an attack frame.
All nine figures must have identical anatomical dimensions: same skull, torso length, waist, arm and leg lengths, same head-to-body ratio as seed. Pose compression comes from bending limbs, NEVER enlarge crouched figures to fill cells. Preserve same facing to screen RIGHT overall; torso can turn to sell the swing.
Same woman huntress: auburn braided hair, dark green sleeveless leather tunic, brown leather bracers and fitted brown trousers/boots, mustard-gold sash strips, bow and quiver stowed on back. TWO SHORT CURVED KNIVES, one in each hand. No drawn bow. Same hand-painted arcade style with clean dark outlines. Do not add plate armor or change physique.
Composition: each full figure isolated within its cell with consistent feet baseline. Keep complete boots, braid and all weapon/effect arcs inside generous transparent gutters. Exact 3x3 arrangement, no touching figures. Transparent background, no ground shadows, no scenery, no labels.
Animation: ONE clean continuous SLASH per strip; blade travels in an ARC, not a forward-pointing stab or straight jab. Smooth body/hip/shoulder rotation and planted leg weight transfer; no jumping, no somersaults, no dodge rolls, no crouch-to-roll. Add a sharp SILVER-WHITE curved knife-trail crescent only at frames 4,5,6 (one-based); trails must visibly join the blade tips, not detached floating effects. Frames 1,2,3 wind up; frame 5 is main contact; frames 6,7,8 follow through/recover. Preserve exact anatomy and clothing throughout.
Strike ONE: diagonal downward sweep from high rear shoulder to low forward-right. Frame1 near seed ready stance. Frame2 step/shift weight onto front leg, knives drawn back. Frame3 right knife chambered above and behind shoulder. Frame4 blade traverses upper diagonal arc. Frame5 main chest-height diagonal cutting contact, torso rotates through. Frame6 knife follows down to right hip with tapering silver crescent. Frame7 settle low-right follow-through, left knife held close. Frame8 low-right chamber, both boots planted, ready to reverse slash. Finish with a calm readable low chamber, not another cut.
